text:
Ryan O'Reilly is 35, and Nashville is getting plenty from him: 17 points in 17 games, seven goals, and 43rd of 506 skaters in our wins added. He's playing 21 minutes a night and still setting up teammates like a top-line center.

The goals need a caveat. He's shooting 23% on just 30 shots, above a talent range that tops out near 18%, and he went three straight games without a shot on goal from Oct. 29 to Nov. 3. At 5v5, Nashville gets only 47% of the expected goals with him on, about what it gets without him. The production is running ahead of the play.

That hot start has made him a trade topic. NHLTradeRumor.com called it a difficult decision for Nashville, Montreal Hockey Fanatics linked the Canadiens, and NHL Trade Rumors ran with "Ryan O'Reilly to be traded by Nashville Predators." The Predators' four-game winning streak complicates any idea of selling. Our projection: 77 points, which would be close to last season's 74.
headline: O'Reilly's hot start, and the shots that stopped
